svg.title: Atlas reporting candidates with marginal uncertainty

cc:Work.dc:title: Atlas reporting candidates with marginal uncertainty
cc:Work.dc:description: Two panels show all 64 county candidates and all 90 purposefully selected pilot tracts, with posterior means and horizontal and vertical 95% marginal intervals. Lower historical income rank and higher incarceration indicate greater need. Colors identify common-grade bands; tract marker shapes identify Montgomery, Russell and Macon counties. The panels use separate geographic comparison frames.
